hebrewText: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֞וּ עָרִ֣ים בְּצֻרוֹת֮ וַ/אֲדָמָ֣ה שְׁמֵנָה֒ וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֡וּ בָּתִּ֣ים מְלֵֽאִים כָּל ט֠וּב בֹּר֨וֹת חֲצוּבִ֜ים כְּרָמִ֧ים וְ/זֵיתִ֛ים וְ/עֵ֥ץ מַאֲכָ֖ל לָ/רֹ֑ב וַ/יֹּאכְל֤וּ וַֽ/יִּשְׂבְּעוּ֙ וַ/יַּשְׁמִ֔ינוּ וַ/יִּֽתְעַדְּנ֖וּ בְּ/טוּבְ/ךָ֥ הַ/גָּדֽוֹל

tokens.bdb: to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
tokens.kjv: cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to gather grapes; also to be isolated
tokens.enLiteralWord: to gather grapes; also to be isolated
tokens.explanation: to gather grapes; also to be isolated
tokens.explanationEn: to gather grapes; also to be isolated

tokens.bdb: soil (from its general redness)
tokens.kjv: country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.

tokens.bdb: greasy, i.e. gross; figuratively, rich
tokens.kjv: fat, lusty, plenteous.

tokens.bdb: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
tokens.kjv: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.enLiteralWord: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.explanation: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.explanationEn: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully
tokens.kjv: [idiom] she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.enLiteralWord: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.explanation: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.explanationEn: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
tokens.kjv: fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

tokens.bdb: a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison)
tokens.kjv: cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

tokens.bdb: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave
tokens.kjv: cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.

tokens.bdb: a garden or vineyard
tokens.kjv: vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).

tokens.bdb: an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry
tokens.kjv: olive (tree, -yard), Olivet.

tokens.bdb: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] carpenter, gallows, helve, [phrase] pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood.
tokens.explanation: ets — árvore, madeira, lenho, madeira como material

tokens.bdb: an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit)
tokens.kjv: food, fruit, (bake-)meat(-s), victual.

tokens.bdb: abundance (in any respect)
tokens.kjv: abundance(-antly), all, [idiom] common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), [idiom] very (age).

tokens.bdb: to eat (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, [idiom] freely, [idiom] in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, [idiom] quite.

tokens.bdb: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

tokens.bdb: to shine, i.e. (by analogy) be (causatively, make) oily or gross
tokens.kjv: become (make, wax) fat.

tokens.bdb: to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively, to live voluptuously
tokens.kjv: delight self.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively
tokens.explanation: to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively
tokens.explanationEn: to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively

tokens.bdb: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
tokens.kjv: fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.
